description: This file defines the PlaywrightConnection class which manages WebSocket communication, dispatching, and cleanup for Playwright's remote connection handling.

classes.name: PlaywrightConnection
classes.description: Manages WebSocket communication, dispatching, and cleanup for Playwright's remote connection.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and disconnection logic when the WebSocket connection is closed or encounters an error.

methods.name: logServerMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata about messages sent and received over the WebSocket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection, optionally with a reason.
